note: New knowledge pack (ticket #807, frontend wave 3). Fences: state-model-rules owns app-tier state ARCHITECTURE judgment generally, incl. the general bypass-inventory METHOD (audit-technique.md) reusable across any sanctioned seam — this pack's persistence-audit-shape.md is the narrower storage-specific checklist and cites that method rather than restating it; reactivity-facts owns reactivity MECHANISM (kernel/recompute/disposal/staleness/scheduling), unrelated to what gets written to storage and when. n01-n07 and n12 are the reciprocal no-trigger cases against both siblings; n08-n11 are unrelated-domain no-trigger cases. Amended ticket #808 (frontend wave 4): data-wiring-facts owns how data gets CONNECTED (streaming stack, bridge protocol, no-DI substitutes, wiring-pattern menu), unrelated to what gets written to storage — n13 is the reciprocal no-trigger case.
